Attendance charge for the locksmith trade, which performed covered work on the affected building component (the back door); 7.1.7(g) allows one attendance per trade for indemnifiable work.
Assembly/fitting of the new lock into the affected door is part of the necessary repair to insured property after break-in damage (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)).
Sundry materials and small parts consumed in the repair of the affected door/lock are indemnifiable as part of the repair cost (7.1.7(f)).
Labour hours for the repair of the affected door/lock are indemnifiable at every grade (7.1.7(e)), as the work was necessary to restore security after break-in damage.
